dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}, it's you? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Huh, what kind of question is that?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I'm certainly not someone who's good at handing out compliments.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I just want to know your feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: ...Pointless. You think I'm some kind of tender soul?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Neither good nor bad. There you go.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hey, have you been watching me while I'm not looking?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: (Darn it... How did I not notice?)

choices.text: You clearly had a gentle expression before...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Didn't think you were the type to get bored... Sure, speak.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything happen recently that makes you want to seek vengeance?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let me think.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Not long ago, I took on an assignment to clear out some nearby Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: On my way back, I rescued a Springvale hunter who was being attacked by a monster.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: ...I didn't expect him to send meat and wine the next day.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Daring to send things despite knowing that I'm the heir to the sinners of Mondstadt... I'll remember this insult.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: The meat was so good that I ate too much and got a stomach ache, so I couldn't properly enjoy the wine...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Haha, we're of the same mind.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Just this simple chat with you has made me feel a lot better...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Ha, a small fry like that monster can't hurt me.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: However, the meat was so good that I ate too much and got a stomach ache, so I couldn't properly enjoy the wine...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It was that delicious? I want some too...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hahaha, best not. If you really want... I'll make a Stormcrest Pie for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: That I'd like to do? Why are you asking?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Because I want to accompany you.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: What a weird statement.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then let me teach you how to dance. Specifically, the "Dance of Sacrifice."

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I told you, I've incorporated dance into my swordplay. If you want to learn my sword techniques, you'll need to learn to dance first.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Actually, dance is also my favorite artistic pastime...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: It's time for you to learn.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Practice your basic dance steps first, then we'll talk.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Such avarice. I ought to reserve the darkest and most grievous of vengeance for you...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But thinking about it... Since we're already this far, then I'll turn a blind eye to any new grievance.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: After all, my vengeance for you runs deep... It has long been inextricable.

choices.text: If I step on your feet...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Then I ought to reserve the darkest and most grievous of vengeance for you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Eula.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ah... Morning.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: #Remember, I have yet to enact vengeance upon you... You better return in one piece, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Eula.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Someone as purehearted as you probably sleeps better than anyone else...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: It's completely furnished, is well-placed, enjoys good lighting... Yes, this bedroom will do just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Some members of the aristocracy hanker after decorations of luxury and beauty, but arrange the room in an absolutely horrific manner... I detest such aristocratic customs.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: But this place... now this a place one can really relax.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: This study... it brings back some memories.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: As a child, I tried all sorts of ways to avoid books that taught aristocratic etiquette, but to no avail — I had no choice but to memorize them all.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Forget it, it's all in the past now. I shouldn't get myself down, I must look ahead to my new life.
